summary: The ansible.builtin.varnames lookup returns a list of Ansible variable names that match given patterns.
questions: How do I find all variables whose names match a pattern?
Is there a way to list defined variable names in a play?
How can I discover variables with a certain prefix?

answer_card.title: List matching variable names with varnames
answer_card.answer_md: `lookup('ansible.builtin.varnames', '<regex>')` returns the names (not values) of Ansible variables matching the regex.
